parsed.title: News Streak Multiplier
parsed.oneLiner: Drive daily reading habit through a gamified streak mechanic that can be doubled by watching rewarded ads.

newMechanic.name: Daily Reading Streak
newMechanic.description: Users earn 1 point for every day they read or save at least one article. Points accrue for achievements and profile badges.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a meaningful, scarce engagement resource to anchor the rewarded ad value exchange.

parsed.trigger: After the user taps 'Save this article' (e38) on the News Feed Home screen (s13), confirming a daily reading action.
parsed.eligibility: All non-paying users who have completed their daily reading goal (saved at least 1 article).

offer.title: Double Your Streak Points
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to double your Daily Streak points for today.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a retention-focused meta-game point (engagement), not a substitute for a paid subscription tier or ad-free access. This creates positive sampling effects for the app without devaluing existing content.

kpis.holdout: 10% of total users held out from the Streak Multiplier offer for 30 days.

risks: Points may be perceived as trivial if they do not unlock tangible benefits like badges or profile themes.
Potential for user fatigue if the multiplier is offered every day without sufficient engagement.

storyboard.caption: User saves a news story, triggering the streak multiplier opportunity.
A prompt invites the user to double their streak points by playing a short game.
